messages:
Samira: quick sync - Orbital Node EAP confirmed for next Tue-Thu. Primary asks: NDA + limited telemetry appendix, bench run, and a short marketplace packaging checklist. Can we list owners? :satellite:
Priya: I'll own NDA edits. Legal wants explicit telemetry fields + retention and a non-disclosure window tied to embargo date. Send draft link.
Marta: bench scope from eng-ml: p95, p99 tail, perf/Watt, and regression correctness on our smoke tests. Also want exported hw counters (temp, power, freq).
Nathan: logistics: partner prefers we bring power meter + NIC. I can source a Fluke and spare 100G. Who's going on-site? Local engineer preferred.
Jae: infra notes: port-mirroring OK, but VPC peering needs security ticket. I'll create SEC-4521. Also confirm we can mirror only metadata (no payload) for privacy.
NDA-bot: NDA draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/nda-orbital-node-v2 - please review and react with :eyes:.
Marta: minimal bench config (dev copy):
```
model=gptx-mini
seq=2048
batch_sizes=1,4,8
metrics=p95,p99,tokens_sec,power_w
telemetry=hw_counters:true,kv_cache:true
```
Samira: marketplace/announcement angle - partner asked to prep a joint preview blurb contingent on EAP results and embargo. We need to coordinate PR lock windows and a short canary plan if we later publish a benchmark.
Priya: legal: add telemetry appendix + 30-day retention + narrow IP carveouts. Also request partner insurance certificate before on-site.
Nathan: got it. I'll collect insurance cert and lab access forms. Can someone share partner POC?
Samira: SI lead is Elena Torres (elena.t@partner.com). I'll loop her in and propose Tue 09:00 PT for handshake.
Jae: security ticket SEC-4521 created. Tagging @security for review; ETA 48h. Will link NDA and bench config.
Marta: pre-run checklist: 1) NDA + telemetry appendix signed 2) Security review cleared 3) Insurance + manifest 4) Bench config uploaded to infra 5) Port-mirroring & peering live 6) On-site personnel confirmed 7) Embargo date synced for any joint announcement
Samira: owners: Priya (legal), Marta (bench), Nathan (logistics), Jae (infra/security). Quick ask - can product draft a 2-line preview blurb for the partner to use behind NDA? Lina from product to pick up?
Nathan: I'll try to get a local field engineer. If not, I'll fly out. Also procuring Fluke meter + NIC.
Priya: sending NDA changes now; will add telemetry appendix template and embargo clause. Need sign-off by Wed EOD to keep Tue slot.
Marta: adding a small regression check to the run: a correctness hash against our golden outputs. We will store only anonymized request ids + counters per legal.
Samira: good. If signatures slip, fallback is partner-hosted nodes (we'll lose some perf isolation). Also, product should confirm if marketplace listing needs extra compliance assets.
Jae: noted. SEC ticket updated with reduced-scope telemetry plan.
Samira: syncing tomorrow 10:00 PT to run through checklist live. React with :thumbsup: on the item you own.
Priya: :thumbsup: (legal)
Marta: :thumbsup: (bench)
Nathan: :thumbsup: (logistics)
Jae: :thumbsup: (infra)
Samira: thanks all. I'll draft a 1-page runbook and an embargo timeline after legal posts the updated NDA.
